subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Frank Abagnale's Many Lives
description: A quick, practical guide to Frank Abagnale's Many Lives.

hook.text: Before turning 21, Frank Abagnale posed as a pilot, doctor, lawyer, and professor.

buildup.text: He cashed $2.5 million in forged checks across 26 countries using charm and fake credentials.

discovery.text: Airlines, hospitals, and universities never verified his identity. Confidence was all he needed.

twist.text: He was caught at 21 and served time in three countries before the FBI recruited him.

climax.text: Abagnale spent his career helping banks prevent the exact fraud he had invented.

punchline.text: The best fraud consultant is a reformed con artist.

quiz.question: What did the FBI eventually do with Frank Abagnale?
options: Recruited him as a fraud consultant
